basis: Original physical49 opened alone, followed by one unresized source-only fig25 crop. Coordinates below are approximate original-page pixels, not inferred mathematical coordinates.

axes.horizontal: Single slightly scan-skewed solid baseline, extending left of the origin and ending in a right-pointing arrow.
axes.vertical: Single solid axis through the origin, extending below the baseline and ending in an upward arrow.

labels.appearance: u-shaped italic glyph with a small p/P-shaped subscript
labels.location: Left of the upper vertical axis, approximately (249,1020).
Below-left of the axis crossing, approximately (258,1149).

curve.style: Solid black connected sawtooth, no dash pattern and no curve arrowheads.
curve.topology: Three rising runs; first two end in abrupt nearly vertical downward resets; final rising run is partial and ends at a blunt visible endpoint.
curve.relationships: Both complete rises cross the baseline before their peaks; both resets cross it downward. The final partial rise also crosses it and ends above it. No invented next reset or continuation.

figures.stroke: Source scan has slightly irregular black strokes and blunt endpoints, not clean idealized geometry.
figures.captionAndSeparation: Figure-number caption is below the diagram around y=1340..1372. Neighboring fig25 apparatus is far to its right. Preserve the complete arrows, low reset vertices and all three diagram labels; caption is separate from these diagram bounds.

apparatus.housing: Tall nearly rectangular black instrument housing with slightly skewed/irregular scanned edges and a broad solid-black lower band.
apparatus.screen: One circular screen with concentric rim outlines, near center (1078,1019), approximately x=913..1246 and y=851..1187.
apparatus.mount: Light plate around the circle with four visible dark ring/disc fasteners, upper-left, upper-right, lower-left and lower-right; none is a control label.

graticule.shape: Orthogonal scanned lattice clipped by the circular screen, not a rectangular panel or table.
graticule.offsets: Approximately 17..19 px between neighboring central-band tracks; small scan drift/skew remains. Outermost vertical tracks near x=920 and x=1237 are short and close to the rim.
graticule.boundary: Horizontal dark bands around y=850..857 and y=1176..1184 belong to/merge with the rim and are not counted as independently distinguishable lattice rows. Edge cells are curved fragments; no rectangular row-by-column cell total is asserted.
graticule.stroke: Dark roughly 3..5 px scanned line cores; overlap with trace and rim locally makes them thicker.
graticule.basis: Visual source crop plus original-pixel central-band dark projections. Projection runs were interpreted against the visible rim/trace, not blindly counted.

curve.style: Single dark continuous solid oscillatory trace, distinguishable from the lattice by thicker/irregular sloping strokes.
curve.topology: From a low left portion, rises to the largest visible crest near (990,938), falls to a large trough near (1026,1086), rises to a smaller crest near (1063,969), falls near (1096,1053), rises near (1133,999), falls near (1166,1038), then rises to a shallow final crest near (1202,1009) and terminates near (1218,1020).
curve.relationships: Excursions shrink toward the right. The low left portion and all visible final small oscillations must remain; do not regularize into a constant-amplitude sinusoid.

figures.axesAndLabels: No drawn coordinate-axis arrows, numeric ticks, units or letter labels inside the screen. Central lattice tracks are not separately labeled axes.

captionAndSeparation.observation: The short instrument-name caption sits immediately below the black housing with only a narrow white separation; the figure-number caption sits farther below. Preceding body prose is above/left. The apparatus must not be shaved to remove the caption. Candidate separation and contamination remain unassessed until candidates are opened.

scope.included: Source-bound RAW figure pixels, apparatus, visible lattice offsets, curve, axes, glyph appearance, arrows, strokes and local crop separation.
scope.excluded: Whole source text review (D269), exact Unicode/script identification from indistinguishable raster glyphs, native stages, edition/modern/course/publish approval, mathematical values absent from source.
